problem: The native scheduler and provider preflight can pass while original source-held commercial tasks remain unconsumed and there are no independently provider-readback-verified emails.
root_cause: The original email-execution watchdog monitors overdue work but does not select another safe original candidate when all available messages are waiting for verified source facts. The scheduler's success is not an end-to-end result.
prevention_rule: On the same original #171 health insert, record a bounded independent guardian decision. When only source-held original emails remain and no provider attempt is ambiguous, allow at most one new original eligibility-gated candidate per hour within the daily five-candidate limit.
further_evidence_required: independent Gmail provider message ID/readback for any send
fix: Bind bounded, safe candidate selection and failure observability to original #171 watchdog, preserve exact provider and contact authority; no new scheduler.
